title: 5 mistakes in a row when taking the back from turtle
whyUseful: Priit Mihkelson walks through the mistakes attackers make in a row when they try to take the back from turtle, which doubles as the map of when to escape.

title: Summer Camp 2017: Turtle seminar with Priit Mihkelson
whyUseful: A full seminar on the turtle as a holdable defensive posture rather than a countdown to losing the back.

title: Winter Camp 2020: Turteling from mount bottom with Priit Mihkelson
whyUseful: Shows how the turtle is reached from a bad bottom position, which is usually how a grappler ends up in it in a real round.

title: Hawking by Priit Mihkelson
whyUseful: Priit explaining one of his own defensive postures and the vocabulary he uses for it, useful for reading the rest of his turtle material.
